headline: 174 lives saved as Indian pilot foils bid to crash plane
summary: Captain Smit Machchhar fought off a co-pilot who allegedly stabbed him and tried to sabotage a flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv.
details: Captain Smit Machchhar, an Indian national, is being hailed as a hero after preventing a disaster on a flydubai flight carrying 174 passengers, including 27 children.

The incident occurred on flight FZ 1073 traveling from Dubai to Ben Gurion International Airport in Israel. According to Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu, a co-pilot stabbed Captain Machchhar and attempted to crash the aircraft.
During the struggle in the cockpit, the plane descended more than 17,400 feet in just two minutes. A crew member and a passenger managed to enter the cockpit and help subdue the suspect.
The aircraft was diverted and landed safely at an airport in Saudi Arabia, where the suspect was arrested and is currently being questioned by Saudi authorities.
Captain Machchhar brings over 13 years of commercial flying experience, having previously spent a decade with Indian carrier SpiceJet before joining flydubai in 2022.
Flydubai has suspended all flights to and from Israel while the incident is investigated. The passengers, including citizens of Israel, India, UAE, and the US, were all reported safe.
caption:
A co-pilot stabbed the captain and tried to crash a plane with 174 people on board. Here is how they survived.

Captain Smit Machchhar, an Indian national, is being hailed as a hero after preventing a disaster on a flydubai flight carrying 174 passengers, including 27 children.

The incident occurred on flight FZ 1073 traveling from Dubai to Ben Gurion International Airport in Israel. According to Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu, a co-pilot stabbed Captain Machchhar and attempted to crash the aircraft.

During the struggle in the cockpit, the plane descended more than 17,400 feet in just two minutes. A crew member and a passenger managed to enter the cockpit and help subdue the suspect.

The aircraft was diverted and landed safely at an airport in Saudi Arabia, where the suspect was arrested and is currently being questioned by Saudi authorities.

Captain Machchhar brings over 13 years of commercial flying experience, having previously spent a decade with Indian carrier SpiceJet before joining flydubai in 2022.

Flydubai has suspended all flights to and from Israel while the incident is investigated. The passengers, including citizens of Israel, India, UAE, and the US, were all reported safe.

headline: 9 killed as Pakistani airstrikes hit Afghanistan
summary: The Taliban government reports that women and children are among the dead following strikes in Helmand and Kunar provinces.
details: Pakistani military launched airstrikes in Afghanistan's Helmand and Kunar provinces on Thursday, resulting in the deaths of nine people.
The Taliban government stated that the victims were civilians, including women and children, while eleven others were wounded and three homes were destroyed.
Pakistan's information ministry confirmed the strikes, describing them as "planned and calibrated" operations targeting terrorist camps and hideouts based on credible intelligence.
In Helmand province, local officials reported that the attack hit Safar village, killing four people and leaving several others critically injured.
The two nations went to war earlier this year, and while a truce was reached in March, sporadic attacks have continued as security issues remain unresolved.
caption:
9 dead, including women and children, after Pakistani airstrikes hit Afghanistan.

Pakistani military launched airstrikes in Afghanistan's Helmand and Kunar provinces on Thursday, resulting in the deaths of nine people.

The Taliban government stated that the victims were civilians, including women and children, while eleven others were wounded and three homes were destroyed.

Pakistan's information ministry confirmed the strikes, describing them as "planned and calibrated" operations targeting terrorist camps and hideouts based on credible intelligence.

In Helmand province, local officials reported that the attack hit Safar village, killing four people and leaving several others critically injured.

The two nations went to war earlier this year, and while a truce was reached in March, sporadic attacks have continued as security issues remain unresolved.
